Seoul Stop is preparing a larger second Baton Rouge location at 6275 Siegen Lane, a 6,000-square-foot space that will expand on the original store's Korean snacks, kimbap, and drinks concept. Vasco's Peri Peri is opening its fourth location at 3124 Route 59 in the Wheatland Marketplace shopping center in Naperville, with owner Samir Ajmeri hoping to debut in July. The restaurant serves Portuguese- and Indian-inspired fried chicken, pitas, wraps, bowls, and platters. Ajmeri will personally own this location, which follows existing units in Schaumburg, Lombard, and Arlington Heights.

The concept, debuting spring 2027, draws inspiration from the original Buitoni Spaghetti Bar that operated in Times Square in the 1940s–1950s, focusing on handmade pasta, elevated comfort dishes, a bar program, and a late-night atmosphere.

Harvey's Deli, a family-owned sandwich shop in Katy, announced its sudden closure on social media on May 13, 2026, after five years in business. Owners Tierra and Ted Tyman cited the struggling economy and extreme overhead costs as reasons for closing.

data.short_description: C.R. Chicks has filed permit applications to open a new location at Wedgewood Commons Shopping Center in Stuart, FL. No official opening date has been announced; this follows a previously announced Boynton Beach location expected to open Fall 2026.

data.location: 675 N Highland Ave NE Suite 6000, Atlanta, GA 30306
data.short_description: Tio Lucho's is hosting its Wine vs. Beer dinner event on May 28, 2026, featuring a five-course Peruvian American dinner paired with both wine and beer selections. The one-night interactive event is held in partnership with podcast A Cork in the Road and presented by James Beard semifinalist Chef Arnaldo Castillo. Tickets are $100 per person and reservations are available via OpenTable.

data.location: 2851 E Eastland Center Dr, Suite 5, West Covina, CA 91791
data.status: awaiting final inspections; hoping to open sometime next month
data.short_description: Changan Kitchen is expanding to Eastland Center in West Covina, marking its sixth location. The restaurant specializes in Chinese noodle dishes and is awaiting final inspections before opening. An exact opening date has not yet been confirmed.

Cozy Soup 'n' Burger, open for 54 years, announced its permanent closure via Instagram, citing rising costs and declining business following the pandemic. The owner acknowledged financial challenges made it impossible to continue operations. The restaurant will close on June 21, 2026.

Mama Canela is a new Tex-Mex restaurant opening in Glendora Village, founded by Paloma Ramos and her husband to fill a gap in the local date-night dining market. The restaurant will feature fajitas, homemade flour tortillas, craft cocktails, and live music. A grand opening celebration with live mariachi music is planned for July 31.
